name: SellToken02
fix_description: In getToken2Price, IRouter.getAmountsOut reads AMM spot price which can be manipulated via flash loan. Fix: use TWAP oracle or Chainlink price feed instead of router getAmountsOut.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a multi-step price manipulation exploit using a flash loan, AMM swaps to pump and dump the token, and protocol-specific short/withdraw interactions across several contracts. The core bug is straightforward oracle misuse, but writing the PoC requires understanding the target router’s short flow and coordinating two flash-loan callbacks, which pushes it beyond easy.
